rule.tasks: 12 fresh N = 32 tasks (seed 3303), one sample each, every arm on every task
rule.primary: exact-set success per arm; service-level errors (misses + false alarms) second
rule.replication_gate: attribution is attempted only if oneshot succeeds on >= 11/12 and team fails on >= 4/12; otherwise the scaling study's failure did not replicate
rule.manipulation_checks: team-system-first: the wrapper reorders every request it sees; team-findings-first: >= 90% of specialist reports put findings before summary; an arm whose check fails is not interpreted
rule.effect: a variant removes the failure if its successes exceed team's by >= 4 and its service-level errors are at most half of team's; it has no effect if its successes are within 2 of team's; anything else is inconclusive
rule.infrastructure: an attempt that saw HTTP 429/5xx or a request without a response is rerun from fresh state, at most 3 attempts per run; only the last attempt is graded; every attempt is kept
rule.scope: exploratory: one model, temperature 0, 12 tasks; no multiplicity correction
